title: Fingers or a Brush?
caption:
Fingers or a Brush?

Fingers, a brush, or a sponge?
I am often asked which one is best for foundation.

The answer depends on the foundation.

Many Japanese foundations spread easily, blend well, and finish with very little effort.
With these, fingers are usually enough.
I often use my fingers too. They give the most natural glow.

A brush can help in other cases.
When you want the skin to look firmer, or when you want to soften the look of pores.
But the right way to use a brush, and the skin it suits, depends on its shape and its hair.

This is something best felt, not read.
Come and try it in a session.
